_comment: OPTIONAL. Copy to %USERPROFILE%\.qonto\config.json (or $env:QONTO_HOME\config.json) to read credentials from Azure Key Vault instead of tokens.json. Contains NO secret: it can be shared, versioned or pushed by Intune. Without this file the toolkit uses tokens.json, as before.

keyvault._doc: clientId = an Entra app registration (public client, no secret) with delegated permission Azure Key Vault / user_impersonation and the redirect URI ms-appx-web://microsoft.aad.brokerplugin/<clientId>. {user} = the part of the Windows sign-in before @, letters and digits only, lower case (jane.doe@contoso.com -> janedoe). Each secret holds the Qonto login and secret key as 'login:secret-key' (split at the first colon). Give each person 'Key Vault Secrets User' on their own secrets only.

no-api-entity.label: Small entity without API access
no-api-entity.note: No Qonto API key for this entity: QOEntite throws an explicit error for this slug on purpose.
